_comment: Single source of truth for plan prices, quotas and the cost inputs behind docs/cost-model.md. scripts/check_pricing_consistency.py fails CI if site/index.html, the billing code, docs/cost-model.md or app/core/pricing.py disagree with this file. Change a price HERE, then run `python scripts/cost_model.py --write` and update site/index.html to match.
billing_code_note: app/api/bff/router.py PLAN_QUOTA_LIMITS is a documented placeholder keyed by DB plan names (free/pro/enterprise), not the public tiers. Pinned here so a change to it cannot go unnoticed; its free value must equal tiers.free.quota (enforced by the checker); pro/enterprise are placeholders, not an endorsement.
